prompt: Build the iconic Easter Island Moai statues: a row of THREE giant monolithic stone figures standing side by side in a line, like the famous Rapa Nui statues. Each Moai has the unmistakable features — a tall rectangular head with a heavy protruding brow ridge, deep-set shadowed eye sockets, a long straight prominent nose, thin pressed lips, a strong jutting chin, elongated rectangular ears down the sides of the head, and a blocky torso buried to about chest height so mostly the head and broad shoulders are visible above ground. Build them from gray stone (STONE and COBBLE blocks, mixed for texture). Make the three statues slightly different heights for natural variation. All three face the same direction, toward the viewer. They should be imposing, weathered, monumental, and instantly recognizable as the Easter Island heads against a green grass background.
